title: COAR launches Retractions Task Force
what_changed: COAR is launching a Task Force (starting December 2026, about nine months) to develop recommended practices for managing retractions in repositories: define terminology (retractions, corrections, removals, expressions of concern), identify methods for detecting retracted articles held in repositories, and set good practices for repositories once a retracted article is found.
why_it_matters: Freely available copies of retracted papers often carry no retraction notice, so orphaned copies keep being read and cited, and repositories can be criticised for spreading discredited science. With rising retraction volumes and AI-generated fake papers, repository-side handling of retractions is becoming a credibility question for open infrastructure.
